paragraphs: AtomAI Solutions sells a suite of software that agencies use to manage assets, work orders, project and utility coordination, permitting, and safety. Its two flagship products are Atom, an asset and maintenance management platform, and Coordinate, formerly dotMaps, a right-of-way and project coordination tool used by state and local agencies across the country.

Work templates can be defined by each agency so that task structures, fields, and workflows match its own operational processes. Forms built inside the platform can include required fields, dropdowns, conditional logic, and photo or video uploads. Every work order records labor hours, equipment usage, and materials consumed, either automatically or through entry in the field. Templated reports are meant to meet compliance and reporting requirements from agencies such as the FHWA, FRA, and EPA.

The company began as an internal startup within SADA Systems Inc. The full team and product suite divested in early 2023 to form AtomAI Solutions, Inc. as an independent company. Since then it has expanded its offerings to include a permitting solution built specifically for state and local governments.
